positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leadership: Led various product teams and subteams through product planning, issue triage, software architecture, and design documentation.

Web: Developed 3D viewer application using WebGL.

Cross-platform Computer Graphics: Modernized and streamlined SketchUp OpenGL graphics pipeline.

Mac OS X Development: Added Mac-specific features to SketchUp and LayOut applications. Helped maintain developer build environment, automated build, and installer.

User Outreach: Attended many user sites and conferences to discuss SketchUp and improve workflow.

Open Source: Championed automated testing within team. Helped maintain gTest C++ testing framework. Contributed fixes to Breakpad crash reporting framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leadership: Led LayOut product team through product planning, issue triage, software architecture, and design documentation.

Cross-platform Development: Added LayOut features including Bezier curve and linear dimension tools.

Mac OS X Development: Added Mac-specific features to LayOut application. Helped maintain developer build environment, automated build, and installer.

User Outreach: Attended many user sites and conferences to discuss LayOut and improve workflow.

Open Source: Championed automated testing within team. Helped maintain gTest C++ testing framework. Contributed to Sidelight, a collection of online graphics tutorials.

positions.title: Associate Technical Staff
positions.description:
Web Services: designed and implemented a 3-tier web service, integrating database, server, and client software.

Computer Graphics and Simulation: created a 3-D simulator for mobile sensor-network algorithm experimentation.

High-performance Computing: designed a high-speed, high-volume data storage system.

Client Interaction: supported client needs through presentations, working group participation, and technical reports.

Wireless Communications: designed and fielded wireless communications technologies for integration into military networks.

Digital Circuit Design: implemented signal processing algorithms in custom digital circuits.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Computer Aided Design: developed a tool for synthesizing digital circuits from software.

Open Source Software: supported user-interface for the open-source digital circuit design language, JHDL.
